description: This source file defines the internal class WorkItemGroup, which manages a group of work items (tasks) for a specific grain context within the Orleans runtime system. It includes mechanisms for enqueuing, executing, and scheduling work items, along with logging and diagnostics functionalities.

classes.name: WorkItemGroup
classes.description: Manages a collection of scheduled tasks associated with a grain context, including scheduling, execution, and diagnostics within the Orleans runtime environment.

methods.name: EnqueueTask
methods.description: Adds a new task to the work item queue and potentially schedules its execution.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Performs scheduled tasks in the queue, handling execution timing and logging long-running turns.

methods.name: GetScheduledTasks
methods.description: Returns the list of tasks currently scheduled in the work group, mainly for debugger purposes.

methods.name: QueueAction
methods.description: Queues an action for execution via the work item scheduler.

methods.name: QueueTask
methods.description: Starts executing a provided task using the work item scheduler.
